correctness.rationale: For A=uu^T, Z factors into two independent normalized Bernoulli counts and a probe-coupled final factor. Exact Rademacher pairing gives E[H²]=2-2/n+1/p3; the product of moments gives the displayed variance for all p_j>0. Strict convexity of log(c+1/p) on (0,1], budget KKT and monotone s(1+(n-1)s)=t(1+(2-2/n)t) give a unique optimizer, t cap, and high-n limits. Independent exact rational enumeration of all original masks/probes for n=2,3 and symbolic/numerical KKT checks agreed.
